items.text: Jadarian Price placed on IR with chest injury; misses min 4 weeks. Seahawks signed Velus Jones Jr.
items.why: Schefter breaking; aggravated at practice; ETR had OUT with Charbonnet.
items.implication: Rookie RB role fully erased short-term; longer-term still viable per Levitan eye test.
items.opportunity: Backfield opens further for remaining SEA RBs; Charbonnet also OUT.

items.text: Keenan Allen downgraded to OUT (groin) vs Commanders in London; Nick Westbrook-Ikhine elevated.
items.why: Schefter/Rapoport downgrade; ETR had Q; DNP Friday.
items.implication: Colts WR depth thin (Pierce IR); Downs locked as top option.
items.opportunity: Josh Downs target/red-zone boost; Tyler Warren TE upside.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Week 4 after hip injury; expected to play, possibly with snap limits per speculation.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury list; Schefter expected to play; full practice clearance reported.
items.implication: WR1 upside returns vs PHI; monitor snap count.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets rebound if no strict limit; Adams share may compress.

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN returning from hamstring; excellent matchup vs DAL.
items.why: ETR list; Rapoport/Texans PR confirmed good to go.
items.implication: Elite WR1 spot; DvP inflates WR scoring most in NFL.
items.opportunity: High target share in favorable implied total game.

items.text: Justin Jefferson OUT for Week 4 with ankle sprain.
items.why: Schefter final out list; ETR OUT; MRI sprain but sits vs MIA.
items.implication: Vikings WR1 void; short-term miss expected.
items.opportunity: Jordan Addison primary beneficiary home vs soft secondary.

items.text: DeVonta Smith ruled OUT vs Rams with hamstring; Goedert also OUT.
items.why: Schefter report; ETR OUT; Baun also out worsens Eagles.
items.implication: Eagles pass game severely depleted vs LAR.
items.opportunity: Increased looks for remaining WRs/TEs; reverse prior beneficiaries if any return.

items.text: Nacua back great but possible snap limits; Collins elite DvP (DAL inflates WR +7.3%) + Texans 7th-most implied points. McConkey LP-DNP-LP foot trend after rib. Eagles sans Smith/Goedert/Baun worse. Addison opportunity with Jefferson out home vs borderline secondary.
items.why: Player-specific data on matchups, practice trends, role voids.
items.implication: Start Collins confidently; Addison must-start; caution Nacua volume/McConkey risk.
items.opportunity: Addison routes/targets spike; Collins high-scoring game script.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad); AD Mitchell and Mason Taylor also OUT for Jets.
items.why: ETR list; Schefter outs confirm; Braelon Allen first-team reps.
items.implication: Jets backfield concentrated; Wilson target share spikes.
items.opportunity: Garrett Wilson elite volume; remaining RB workhorse path.

items.text: Mike Evans intends to play through ribs (GTD/Q, compression plan); Lamar Jackson off report/full, expected to start (no panic on back).
items.why: Rapoport on Evans intent; Schefter Jackson off IR/report.
items.implication: Evans likely plays but monitor; Jackson full go.
items.opportunity: If Evans sits, Kittle/others rise; Jackson QB1 locked.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren: 90% snaps, 20/22 RB touches last week; Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game. Top-10 play.
items.why: Workhorse usage + matchup; short week no issue.

items.text: LOVE Jeremiyah Love (26 touches, double-digit target share, Giants soft vs run); Drake London (35%+ TS with Penix, NO soft vs WR); Garrett Wilson (36% TS sans Mitchell, CHI soft).
items.why: Utilization spikes + matchups; Hall/Mitchell outs boost Wilson.
items.implication: Start all three confidently in favorable spots.
items.opportunity: Love volume monster; London/Wilson target monsters.

items.text: LOVE Josh Downs (31% TS, 43% RZ looks, WAS soft vs WR/slot; Allen OUT boosts); George Kittle (climbing share, Evans GTD, DEN soft vs TE); Trevor Lawrence (high total @ CIN, prior success).
items.why: Target/RZ data + injuries/matchups; Allen OUT amplifies Downs.
items.implication: Strong start candidates; Downs especially elevated.
items.opportunity: Downs primary WR; Kittle TE1 path if Evans limited.

items.text: Jadarian Price tough early runout: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass to Holani, back-to-back fumbles, chest hurt, Charbonnet practicing. Still passes eye test; far from over long-term.
items.why: Usage erosion data + injury before IR placement.
items.implication: Short-term stash only; monitor return post-IR.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton (low 42% snaps, 3.5% TS, 25% routes, SEA stout vs run); Justin Herbert (high pressure, SEA elite pass D, low implied total).
items.implication: Sit/fade both; Hampton role concerns persist.
items.conflict: Usage data conflicts any volume hope for Hampton.
